subject: Indian History
front: At which Indus Valley Civilization site was the famous 'Great Bath' (विशाल स्नानागार) discovered?
back: Mohenjo-daro (discovered by Rakhaldas Banerjee in 1922, currently in Sindh, Pakistan).

subject: Indian History
front: Which Harappan city is renowned for having an ancient tidal dockyard connected to the Arabian Sea?
back: Lothal (situated on the Bhogava river in Gujarat).

subject: Indian History
front: Who wrote the famous ancient treatise 'Indica' describing the administration and society of Pataliputra?
back: Megasthenes (Greek ambassador of Seleucus I Nicator to the court of Chandragupta Maurya).

subject: Indian National Movement
front: Who led the 1857 First War of Independence in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh?
back: Begum Hazrat Mahal (on behalf of her minor son Birjis Qadr).

subject: Indian National Movement
front: Which violent incident in Gorakhpur district led Mahatma Gandhi to withdraw the Non-Cooperation Movement in February 1922?

subject: Geography
front: Which river is widely known as the 'Dakshin Ganga' or 'Ganga of the South' due to its length and sacred status?
back: Godavari River (longest peninsular river in India originating at Trimbakeshwar, Maharashtra).

subject: Geography
front: Through which city in Uttar Pradesh does the Indian Standard Meridian (82°30' E) pass?
back: Mirzapur (near Prayagraj, UP), which is 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of GMT (+05:30).

subject: Indian Constitution & Public Administration
front: Which Constitutional Article was described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution'?
back: Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies through Writs).

subject: Indian Constitution & Public Administration
front: Which Constitutional Amendment added the 11th Schedule containing 29 functional items for Panchayats?
back: 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 (enforced from 24 April 1993 - National Panchayati Raj Day).

subject: Indian Economy
front: Who is universally recognized as the Father of the Green Revolution in India?
back: Dr. M.S. Swaminathan (introduced high-yielding semi-dwarf wheat varieties from CIMMYT).

subject: Indian Economy
front: In which year were 14 major commercial banks first nationalised in India by the Indira Gandhi government?

subject: General Science
front: Deficiency of which water-soluble vitamin causes Beriberi?

subject: General Science
front: What optical phenomenon explains the brilliant twinkling of stars in the night sky?
back: Atmospheric refraction of starlight through varying density layers of Earth's atmosphere.

subject: UP GK
front: What is the official State Bird and State Tree of Uttar Pradesh?
back: State Bird: Sarus Crane (सारस). State Tree: Ashoka (अशोक).

subject: UP GK
front: Which prominent river in Uttar Pradesh originates from Fulhar Jheel (Gomat Taal) in Pilibhit?
back: Gomti River (flows through Lucknow and joins Ganga at Kaithi, Ghazipur).

subject: General Hindi
front: 'हिमालय' शब्द का सही सन्धि-विच्छेद एवं सन्धि का प्रकार क्या है?
back: हिम + आलय = हिमालय (दीर्घ स्वर सन्धि: अ + आ = आ).

subject: General Hindi
front: 'स्थावर' शब्द का विलोम शब्द क्या है?

subject: General English
front: What is the antonym of the word 'BENEVOLENT'?
back: Malevolent / Cruel / Spiteful (Benevolent = kind and generous).

subject: Logic & Reasoning
front: How many odd days are there in a normal non-leap year of 365 days?
back: 1 odd day (365 / 7 = 52 weeks + 1 remaining day). In a leap year (366 days), there are 2 odd days.
